text:
Tara (product): Quick sync 4 Q3 roadmap has two knife-edge items: ACME private pilot + Beta multi-tenant prewarm. Need clear sequencing and launch gates. Who can own gating checklist?
Mike (eng-runtime): I can take runtime gate. main concerns: KV cache eviction behavior under tenant churn, and warm pool sizing. Need perf targets from product.
Tara (product): Target: p95 gen latency < 120ms for 512 tokens, and <10% tail regressions vs current baseline. Also a rollback criteria: if error rate > 1% for 5m during canary.
Sofia (eng-infra): Infra needs lead time for dedicated burst slots. If runtime needs prewarm pools per-tenant, we'll need capacity estimates by EOD Friday. Also we need a network egress stub for ACME.
Raj (security): For ACME private pilot we need HSM key wrapping and audit log retention 90d. Also threat model signoff before private deployment. Can Kayla own customer acceptance for compliance items?
Kayla (solutions): Yep, I can coordinate ACME compliance checklist and get their security contact looped in. We'll need a short doc for what data touches Redwood vs. customer-only.
Mike (eng-runtime): On rollout policy: propose canary 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if SLOs hold. Auto-fallback to smaller quantized variant if latency spikes.
Tara (product): Sounds good. Add explicit evaluation prompts to catch quality regressions. Kayla  can you own eval set for ACME?
Kayla (solutions): I'll assemble a 50-case eval focusing on hallucination-sensitive intents and long-context behavior. Deliver by Thu.
Sofia (eng-infra): For burst slots I need an initial estimate: expected QPS per tenant at peak and KV cache hit rate assumptions. Mike, can you provide a short calc?
Mike (eng-runtime): Quick calc: assume 3 RPS per user at peak, 100 concurrent users => 300 RPS. With batching and prewarm, we can hit 120 tokens/s per GPU for model-x; estimate 3 GPUs for SLO headroom. I'll drop numbers in #eng-runtime after this thread.
Raj (security): Note on private deploy: KMS integration adds ~2s to cold start if not warmed. That's fine for background jobs but impacts first-request latency. We should document that in launch notes.
Tara (product): Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) Perf SLOs met in staging load test, 2) Eval quality within delta threshold, 3) Security signoff, 4) Capacity slots reserved, 5) Runbook + rollback tested. Anyone object?
Mike (eng-runtime): Add: automated fallback toggle validated (test both model fallback and traffic reroute).
Sofia (eng-infra): Add: infra autoscaler cooldowns validated under surge (I can run a chaos test).
Raj (security): Add: audit log retention and KMS rotation tested with customer keys.
Tara (product): OK  owners: runtime gate = Mike, infra gate = Sofia, security gate = Raj, customer eval = Kayla. I'll be the launch decision owner.
Kayla (solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min cross-team checkpoint Thursday 9am PT to confirm the delivered artifacts.
Mike (eng-runtime): Minor ops note: we should plan for a degraded mode where we drop to a smaller model if GPUs are saturated. Need infra agreement on quick routing rule.
Sofia (eng-infra): Agree  can implement a routing policy that sends overflow to dedicated cheap-variant pool. Need the exact rule (latency threshold or rejection rate).
Tara (product): Use latency threshold + error budget consumption. We'll codify thresholds in the runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary started for beta-prewarm on staging at 1765436788  monitoring hooks attached.
Mike (eng-runtime): Saw the canary start  initial latency looks fine. I'll validate KV cache hit rate and warm pool occupancy in next 10m.
Tara (product): Thanks everyone. Action items: Mike: detailed capacity calc in #eng-runtime; Sofia: autoscaler surge test; Raj: threat model doc and KMS test plan; Kayla: ACME eval + customer compliance doc. Meet Thu 9am PT.
Sofia (eng-infra): Noted. If anyone needs a capacity spike window, ping infra-ops@redwood.
Raj (security): I'll post a short checklist in this thread once I confirm the HSM timelines.
Kayla (solutions): Will share eval link and invite ACME contact.
Mike (eng-runtime): Dropping quick snippet for autoscaling policy we discussed:
```
# autoscale policy
min_replicas: 2
scale_target: cpu_utilization
target: 65%
cooldown: 120s
burst_buffer: 2
```
Tara (product): Perfect. Keeping this thread as the canonical prelaunch alignment. If anything changes, flag asap. :thumbsup:
